t: A low-power NXP wireless chip for Matter, Thread, Zigbee, and Bluetooth devices.
steps: Buy the FRDM-MCXW71 board from a distributor like DigiKey, Future Electronics, or Avnet.
Install Zephyr and its west tool on your computer by following the Zephyr getting started guide.
Run west blobs fetch hal_nxp to download the radio files.
Connect the board over USB to its onboard MCU-Link debugger.
Flash the matching radio core firmware with blhost in ISP mode.
Build and flash the blinky sample for the frdm_mcxw71 board.
Try a Bluetooth peripheral sample next, then NXP's Matter demo guide.
meta: Open Code. From $27.80. A few stores.
